purpose: Declare the GLB pairs that tree-impostor-lab.ts (and tests/tree-asset-lighting.browser.mjs) accept but that are NOT in this repository, so a fresh clone knows where they come from and how to verify them.
status: documentation-only; written 2026-10-04 by migration-prep (backlog task 21); no asset was moved, copied or regenerated
why-external: The lab takes the GLB pair from a file picker plus a capture directory whose manifest pins input hashes (manifest.input.files). The parent IWSDK repository keeps them under Assets/_assetctl/, which is ignored by the parent allowlist .gitignore.

parentRepository.note: Cloning universe-atlas alone does not provide these files. Regenerate with tools/assetctl at the revision recorded in the family brief, or obtain them as a separately authorised artifact transfer.
